notes.title: May Update
notes.notes:
Some transport vehicles can deploy teleporters, when near one, players can teleport to other deployed teleporters on the map which should make it easier to travel between main base and frontlines. Added a new WIP map. Various bug fixes
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VwqLjGa.jpg[/img]

notes.title: April Update 2
notes.notes: Added voice chat proximity and team, removed melee in favor of equipped knife

notes.title: April Update 1
notes.notes: Added more transport vehicles, map will display relevant friendly players and vehicles, zombie test ... various bug fixes.

notes.title: March Update 2
notes.notes:
All Directional Multipurpose Missiles for planes, rocket launcher projectile will now home in on vehicles if a target is locked, working counter measures for air vehicles also land vehicles that can deploy them. Various Bug fixes.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pgKG7iN.jpg[/img]

notes.title: March Update
notes.notes: Added weapon selection option for each class, SpecOps class will permanently unlock after 100 matches have been won by a player or team base has been upgraded to level 3 or user is a server administrator, new sounds for vehicles like planes and helicopters, various bug fixes.
